data.content:
Fixed the `@matrix-org/matrix-sdk-crypto-wasm` v18 compatibility breakage.

Updated rendezvous QR code usage to use `QrCodeIntent` under the legacy `QrCodeMode` name, restored compatibility typings for `QrCodeMode` and `OlmMachine.getIdentity`, and added a Vitest runtime shim so existing tests/imports of the removed `QrCodeMode` export continue to work against v18.

`pnpm lint:types`, `pnpm lint:js`, and the full `pnpm vitest run --pool=forks` suite pass against `matrix-sdk-crypto-wasm` 18.0.0.
